The library facts they reuse are the ones cited in the child proofs. The only blocking defect from v1 is confirmed and repaired. Mathlib's exists_partition_approximatesLinearOn_of_hasFDerivWithinAt takes r : (E →L[ℝ] F) → ℝ≥0 with rpos : ∀ A, r A ≠ 0, and the unit-sphere minimum used in v1 does not exist for n = 0. subproblem.title: The tangent-plane projection of a C² submanifold extends to a C¹ field on a neighbourhood
subproblem.statement: Let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold. Then there are an open set O ⊇ N and a map pr : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P), C¹ on O, with pr(z) equal to the orthogonal projection onto span(T_zN) (= T_zN) for every z ∈ N.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → ∃ (O : Set (Euclid P)) (pr : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), IsOpen O ∧ N ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 pr O ∧ ∀ z ∈ N, pr z = (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace N z)).starProjection
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 2 §4 (P_N(z) is C¹ along a C² submanifold) and step 6 of the parent proof, where the C¹ field P(π(·)) is used (π the nearest point projection); here any C¹ extension of P_N serves and is built from local charts and a partition of unity.
1. Projection along charts. For z ∈ N let P_N(z) := starProjection(span ℝ (tangentSpace N z)). For a chart (V, W, ψ) of N and v ∈ V, the sibling chart_tangentSpace_eq_range_fderiv gives tangentSpace N (ψ v) = range Dψ(v), a linear subspace, so span(tangentSpace N (ψ v)) = range Dψ(v) and P_N(ψ(v)) = Γ(Dψ(v)), where for injective linear L : ℝ^d → ℝ^P, Γ(L) := L(L*L)^{-1}L* is the orthogonal projection onto range L. Γ is C^∞ on the open set of injective linear maps (inversion is smooth).
2. Local extensions. Fix p ∈ N and a chart (V, W, ψ), ψ ∈ C²(V), with p = ψ(v_p). Let F_p := (range Dψ(v_p))^⊥ and Ψ_p(a, w) := ψ(v_p + a) + w (a ∈ V − v_p, w ∈ F_p); Ψ_p is C² with DΨ_p(0,0)(h, k) = Dψ(v_p)h + k invertible. By the C² inverse function theorem (Mathlib ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph, ContDiffAt.to_localInverse) there is an open product of balls B_p = B'_p × B''_p ∋ (0,0) on which Ψ_p is injective, O'_p := Ψ_p(B_p) is open and the inverse Φ_p : O'_p → B_p is C². As ψ is a homeomorphism of V onto N ∩ W (proper, injective, continuous), there is ρ > 0 with N ∩ B_ρ(p) ⊆ ψ(v_p + B'_p). Put O_p := O'_p ∩ B_ρ(p) ∩ W. For z ∈ N ∩ O_p: z = ψ(v_p + a) = Ψ_p(a, 0) with a ∈ B'_p, so Φ_p(z) = (a, 0). Define Π_p(y) := Γ(Dψ(v_p + π_1(Φ_p(y)))) for y ∈ O_p, where π_1(a, w) := a. Since Φ_p is C², Dψ is C¹ (ψ ∈ C²) with injective values on V, and Γ is smooth, Π_p is C¹ on O_p; and for z ∈ N ∩ O_p, Π_p(z) = Γ(Dψ(v_p + a)) = P_N(ψ(v_p + a)) = P_N(z) by step 1.
3. Gluing. O := ⋃_{p∈N} O_p is open and contains N. As an open subset of ℝ^P, O is a σ-compact (Hausdorff) smooth manifold, and (O_p)_{p∈N} is an open cover of O. Apply Mathlib SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate on the manifold O with the closed set s := O (all of the manifold): this gives a smooth partition of unity (λ_i)_{i∈I} on O with values in [0,1], tsupport λ_i ⊆ O_{p(i)}, locally finite, and Σ_i λ_i = 1 at every point of O. (Equivalently, one may note that N is closed in O — each N ∩ W_p = ψ_p(V_p) is closed in W_p by properness and O_p ⊆ W_p — but only Σ_i λ_i = 1 on N is used below.) Define pr(y) := Σ_i λ_i(y)Π_{p(i)}(y) for y ∈ O (the term is taken to be 0 where λ_i(y) = 0; near each point only finitely many terms are nonzero, and each nonzero term is C¹ on a neighbourhood) and pr(y) := 0 for y ∉ O. Then pr is C¹ on O.
4. On N. For z ∈ N, only indices with z ∈ tsupport λ_i ⊆ O_{p(i)} contribute, and for them Π_{p(i)}(z) = P_N(z) by step 2; hence pr(z) = (Σ_i λ_i(z))P_N(z) = P_N(z) = (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace N z)).starProjection. (If N = ∅ take O = ∅, pr = 0.)
proof_key_steps: Along a chart, P_N(ψ(v)) = Γ(Dψ(v)) with Γ(L) = L(L*L)^{-1}L* smooth, since T_{ψ(v)}N = range Dψ(v).
Straightening by (a, w) ↦ ψ(v_p + a) + w and the C² inverse function theorem give C¹ local extensions Π_p near each p ∈ N.
A smooth partition of unity on O = ⋃O_p glues them into a C¹ field equal to P_N on N.

audit.reason: The chart projection formula, local straightening and a partition of unity on the open neighbourhood construct the claimed C¹ extension. The proof requires no global closedness of N and handles N empty.
